build_ContrastManager: build a ContrastManager instance with a DictConfig, example Camera, valid mask dict, and SceneType for contrastive lifting
create_get_mask_onelabel: create a single-label segmentation mask from a gzip pickled detection result file and optionally resize it
create_get_mask_multilabel: create a multi-label segmentation mask from a gzip pickled detection result file with optional resizing and rotation
run_contrastive_loss: run contrastive loss computation on sampled pixel features with integer or multi-hot instance labels and temperature
review_ContrastManager_compute_loss: review the ContrastManager compute_loss method that samples valid pixels and computes contrastive loss on rendered features
